rationale: The agent identified the user and reviewed multiple orders, then executed an exchange on order #W3470184. However, there is no evidence of explicit user authentication beyond name/ZIP, no user confirmation before performing the order-changing write, and no confirmation of payment/refund details. The agent also selected a new item and payment method (gift card) without documented consent and provided no final details of the exchange outcome. These violate the policy requirements to confirm before changes and provide correct final information, so the interaction fails.
